goal: Reconstruct the public/private funding allocation for the White House ballroom, integrated East Wing/military-security project, and broader White House construction program using primary accounting, transfer, obligation, contract, and donor records.
promotion_boundary: Do not promote a zero-taxpayer or taxpayer-share finding beyond the scope directly supported by primary records. Do not infer motive from a funding discrepancy alone.

tasks.release_condition: Primary statement preserved with exact private-funding and Secret Service security language.
Government characterization of the integrated military complex and secure ballroom is independently reproducible from the preserved filing.

tasks.object: NPS East Wing modernization / State Ballroom FONSI and associated environmental record
tasks.release_condition: Official project-scope chronology is preserved and separates modernization, demolition, ballroom, security, and related actions.
Every reported government-agency transfer into the White House maintenance account is independently traceable to an authoritative record.

tasks.object: Secret Service project expenditures and obligations
tasks.release_condition: Taxpayer-funded Secret Service work associated with the ballroom/East Wing project can be summed without conflating unrelated protective operations.

tasks.object: White House Military Office project expenditures and transfers
tasks.release_condition: Military Office funding associated with the integrated project is reconstructable and distinguishable from unrelated White House operations.

tasks.object: Contractor cost summary underlying reported approximately $600 million East Wing project estimate
tasks.release_condition: The reported $600 million figure is attributable to an identified document with bounded scope and revision date.

tasks.object: Private donor receipt and pledge accounting
required_capture: donor or donor-class record where legally public
tasks.release_condition: Private contributions can be compared to actual project obligations without treating pledges as expenditures.

tasks.object: Broader White House modernization project ledger
tasks.release_condition: The reported $900M-$927M broader construction total is reproducible from project-level records.
Each public cost figure is mapped to its contemporaneous project scope so incompatible denominators are never compared as if they were the same estimate.

duplicate_execution_rule: Before acquiring an object, check the source-posture packet, evidence receipts, and this queue for an existing preserved object or verified hash. Reuse existing custody rather than recapturing the same source.
completion_condition: Primary records support a reproducible project-by-project and funding-source-by-funding-source accounting sufficient to classify the zero-taxpayer claim without relying on secondary reporting for the decisive allocation.
